scope.status: Body counts and major weapon stocks confirmed. Only the extra Warden shoulder-pad count remains open.

notes: The fixed sword-and-shield model is additional to the removable sword and shield stock.
These nine bodies are separate from the nine Sagittarum bodies and four dedicated foot captain bodies.

Each can be fielded either as Shield-Captain or as an ordinary Custodian Guard.

physical_pools.name: Sagittarum Custodian bodies

notes: All nine bodies may be assigned as ordinary Allarus or captains.
Open heads are visual cues only and do not create additional physical models.

Venatari lance configurations consume removable spear components from this pool.

sisters_of_silence.note: All ten bodies are unassembled; weapon bits are not the limiting factor.

telemon.note: Two magnetized hulls; only two copies of each arm type.

venatari.venatari_lances: drawn from Custodian Guard removable spear pool

hard_constraints.rule: The magnetized Forge World captain body can be either one Shield-Captain or one Blade Champion, never both.
Maximum physically representable Blade Champions at one time: 2.
Nine Guard bodies: five flexible, three fixed spears, one fixed sword-and-shield.
Nine complete Sagittarum models are confirmed. A tenth weapon set is not available/confirmed, so the physical maximum is nine until another set is sourced.
Ten Wardens have ten confirmed shoulder-pad pairs. Extra full-arm loadout sets require extra pads or a wrist-level magnetization plan.
Every Allarus Captain uses one of the same nine physical Allarus bodies.
Every Dawneagle Shield-Captain uses one of the same six bike frames as Vertus Praetors.
Venatari lance configurations consume spear components from the Custodian Guard removable weapon pool.
One Caladius hull can use either iliastus or arachnus main armament, never both as separate tanks.
Each of the two Guard-derived captain bodies can be either one Shield-Captain or one ordinary Custodian Guard, never both.
Maximum simultaneous sword-and-shield models from confirmed stock: seven (six removable sword arms plus one fixed sword-and-shield model).
Ten Sisters of Silence bodies exist and all ten remain on sprue. They may be assembled in any mix of Prosecutors, Witchseekers, Vigilators, and one Knight-Centura, subject only to the ten-body limit.
Two copies exist of each Telemon arm type. A single Telemon may use both copies, or one copy may be allocated to each hull.
All six Venatari can simultaneously use kinetic destroyer and tarsus buckler.

open_questions.question: How many extra Custodian Warden shoulder-pad pairs were ordered separately?
open_questions.impact: Determines whether full-arm loadout swaps are possible beyond one permanent pair per body. This does not prevent building all ten Wardens.

audit_notes: The 4485-point New Recruit export is a collection display, not a physically exact simultaneous army.
The roster displays 63 models; the owner-confirmed physical inventory totals 75, including five shared Imperial Agents.
Nine complete Sagittarum are confirmed; the roster's tenth model lacks a confirmed weapon set.
Both Telemons are fully magnetized with two copies of each arm type.
All six Venatari have complete magnetized kinetic destroyer and tarsus buckler sets.
The two Guard-derived captain bodies are role-flexible and may become ordinary Custodian Guard.
All final army generation must allocate physical bodies first, then roles, then shared weapon components.
All ten Sisters of Silence bodies remain on sprue; none are currently assembled.
Fifteen copies of each weapon type are available, so the ten-body count is the only practical limit.
